name: stick
note: Stick response (ps2_stick, src/game/hooks.cpp), by the way Hector faces from the camera's heading (he faces where he walks; the camera turns in the courtyard): PS2, the default, lets a small tilt through as the PS2 did, so he walks slowly any way it points (a diagonal: 45 degrees); Xbox cuts each axis to 0 under a third of its throw, so the same tilt does not move him, and a tilt near right (15.5 degrees off it) walks straight right, where PS2 keeps the 74.5 degrees.
